title: Scroll mode toggle button on Microsoft Mouse Precision fails to switch back to tactile mode when connected via Bluetooth after updating to PowerToys 0.93.0
summary: The new report reproduces the mechanical ratchet failure on both Windows and Linux and restores it by external USB power, favoring a device power/actuator issue rather than PowerToys. That is evidence for the new reporter's unit, not proof of the original unit's hardware diagnosis; run the same power/PowerToys-exit control before closing the original report.

reproduce.title: Verify Microsoft Precision mouse Bluetooth control report
reproduce.version_requirement: Original PowerToys 0.93 report; current supported build as control
prerequisites: Microsoft Precision mouse Bluetooth control enabled where applicable
setup: Use the affected mouse, normal manufacturer software and a known-good external USB power source.
No battery disassembly or firmware modification is required.
steps: 1. Fully exit PowerToys, connect by Bluetooth and compare free-spin to tactile switching.
2. Keep Bluetooth active, add external USB power and repeat.
3. Compare ordinary wired USB behavior; if available, retain the separate Linux result rather than infer it for a different unit.
4. If failure exists only while PowerToys is running, reopen investigation with that specific module differential instead of closing as hardware.
reproduce.expected_result: A power-dependent failure that persists with PowerToys exited is routed to device support; a PowerToys-only control remains eligible for software investigation.
